motivation: The completed ranker improves aggregate AC but not authentic-history contribution or nonAC preservation. Observe candidate behavior on authenticated public statement samples instead of predicting that behavior from edit similarity.
selection: Reuse every frozen OOF score; no fit, calibration, threshold search, new candidate or recipient exclusion.
Execute all unique existing candidate identities, including current/noop, only on the authenticated statement sample set.
Require four complete identical known verdict vectors under worker counts 1,8,8,1; otherwise public observation remains unavailable.
If current public observation is unavailable or the sample set is empty, retain the original frozen choice, explicitly marked fallback.
Otherwise retain candidates with stable public observations that preserve every currently passing public case, including the identical current/noop candidate.
Maximize public pass count, then frozen C_joint OOF score, then ascending candidate SHA256. This is C_exec.
For matched diagnostics, apply the identical admissible set and pass-count rule to all other frozen score arms, keeping noop exactly current. Do not choose the best arm after results.
Seal all320 predictions before opening the pinned existing private assessment-label file. The prediction worker does not open private testcase bodies.

execution.runner: unchanged SandboxRunner and run_source via measured_block

comparison.component: C_exec versus frozen C_joint, with pooled and equal-problem AC strictly higher and regression lower/upper nonworse, also on known_nonAC; known_AC AC nonworse, unknown counts nonincreasing, and nonworse AC in at least4/5 folds
comparison.zpd: Run the unchanged fourteen-method assessment on all equally execution-filtered arms. All original correctness, regression, mechanism and joint-current gates remain required for any ZPD method claim.
comparison.scope: Repeatedly exposed adaptive development only. No comparison with the separate997/250 Seen/Unseen paper evaluation and no claim of learning effects.

continuation.on_execution_error: Retain partial journal and failure state; no implicit retry or private assessment.
continuation.on_component_failure: Retain the complete negative result; decompose unavailable/current-all-pass/ranking failures without changing this rule.
continuation.on_component_success_only: Keep as a development execution-selection component; no canonical promotion. Diagnose remaining errors and design a separately frozen next experiment. History failure remains visible.
continuation.on_all_gates_success: Prepare independent verification and an untouched-cohort protocol; no automatic paper update.
